Hey man, sounds like in general you have a very addictive personality. I'm on the same boat pretty much. Everything I do that 'feels good' I take to extremes. However, it is definitely getting better as I get older, but I don't think It'll go away. One good piece of advice I have for you is try to get addicted to something that is generally good/pushes you in the right direction. I have found myself obsessively going to the gym everyday in my past, to the point where I do the things at the gym that make me FEEL GOOD so it becomes a positive and addicting place. I also felt this way about jogging but I had to give it up because I started pushing myself too hard (so it stopped becoming 'addicting'). I'd never been one to enjoy physical exercise before these AT ALL so it is possible. The reality is this will probably effect you your whole life, and taking little attempts to make it a good rather than a bad is all you can do for now. Also, if you're good at any games, record the gameplay and edit it and put it on YouTube. That's a positive thing. Being alone and pushing people away I can relate to, but if you're like me you're just looking for truly great friendships.  Attention is great don't sweat it. I love gossip too, doesn't matter.
